note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on Salesforce data vs. file storage and capacity planning. No screenshots per this course's conceptual/architecture no-screenshot policy for Chapter 2 — taught through prose, a forecasting checklist, and a written lab scenario. Specific org-wide allocation figures (base GB and per-user MB/GB by edition) were deliberately left out of this lesson: multiple secondary sources describing Salesforce's own documentation give conflicting numbers for those figures, and the official help.salesforce.com storage-allocation article renders via JavaScript and could not be fetched directly to confirm current values, so the lesson teaches the allocation mechanism (edition- and user-count-based, visible in Setup > Storage Usage, calculated asynchronously) without stating an unverified number. The per-record fixed-size principle and the asynchronous-calculation behavior are corroborated across multiple independent descriptions of Salesforce's documented storage rules.
